title: 思い出の味でフィーバー☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Maruzensky goes shopping with two younger students to help them buy some training clothes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: This brand offers UV protection. It's very functional—and totally fresh to boot! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow! I used to choose clothes just because the color was cute or because they were cheap…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You can learn a lot by listening to your elders. Thank you for teaching us, Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Think nothing of it! ♪ You can ask me for help anytime! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So it is. Let's get our grub on!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Are we eating at the food court today? Wow, there sure are a lot of stores here!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, they have Japanese food and dessert shops here! ♪ I see you took our tastes into consideration!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Always happy to please! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That place is selling the same tiramisu I used to eat as a kid!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The store sign reads, "Bubbly Deluxe - The Fountain of Youth."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My mother used to take me there on the way back from shopping in Harajuku…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! It says they have Hokkaido melon!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: They appear to sell tiramisu, prosciutto-wrapped melon, and other dishes you'd serve at a party.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: They sell party dishes? That's so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We can't waste this opportunity! Let's have a party! It'll be off the hook!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We can't waste this opportunity! Let's have a party! It'll be off the hook!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Nngh… I know I should, but this place looks so great…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh! Why don't we all split some? I'd love to share those far-out flavors with you guys!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We all buy an item we really want to try and then split everything with each other.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mmm, melon and cheese from Hokkaido! It tastes jus' like home!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Like they say, "appreciate the old, and discover the new." Japan has a long tradition of incorporating Western elements.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's the bomb! ♪ I'm glad we're all getting to try it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone is able to enjoy delicious food without having to worry too much about the calorie count.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's the way! Let's eat up, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We all buy an item we really want to try and then split everything with each other.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mmm-mm! I'm going full throttle to sample each and every dish! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The sea urchin, crab, and shrimp are all so good! I never thought I'd be able to eat like this in Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: These boxes are simply stuffed with food! This is the best day ever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We'll remember this meal our whole lives! ☆ This is the bomb! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky and the others stuff themselves silly with all the lavish dishes.
